testcase.name: Scenario: Activate and cancel viewport pan: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-zQWQzn/checkout/features/application/viewport-pan/viewport-pan.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Activate and cancel viewport pan ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the viewport navigation bar is visible ✔ When the user selects Pan on the navigation bar ✔ Then Pan is active ✔ And the Pan control is highlighted ✔ And the status area prompts the user to pan the current view and indicates cancellation is available ✔ And the active part and solid remain visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the status area returns to Ready ✔ And the active part and solid remain visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel Pan by clicking the viewport: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-zQWQzn/checkout/features/application/viewport-pan/viewport-pan.feature:18:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel Pan by clicking the viewport ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport without dragging ✔ Then Pan ends and the status area displays Ready ✔ And the same part and solid remain visible in their previous view
